description_en: Modifies the attributes of acceleration regions in an acceleration area for a Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用UpdateIpSets接口修改加速区域中的多个加速地域
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-ip-sets --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ip-sets IpSetId=ips-bp11c9mpphtb1xkds0000 Bandwidth=4 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIpSets

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The new bandwidth that you want to allocate to the acceleration regions. Unit: Mbit/s.

You must allocate at least 2 Mbit/s of bandwidth to each acceleration region. You can specify the bandwidth for up to 100 acceleration regions
fields.help_zh:
要修改的加速地域带宽。单位：Mbps。

每个加速地域支持分配的最小带宽为2 Mbps。
您最多可输入100个加速地域带宽
fields.name: bandwidth

fields.help_en:
The IDs of the acceleration regions that you want to modify.

You can specify the IDs of up to 100 acceleration regions
fields.help_zh:
要修改的加速地域ID。

您最多可输入100个加速地域ID
fields.name: ip_set_id
